title.zh: 币安疑似遭大规模黑客攻击，Tether与Circle冻结相关稳定币

current_state.zh: Binance仍在调查一起潜在安全事件，CZ称其似乎遭到攻击但用户资金安全；Tether已冻结15.67亿USDT，Circle冻结超过8亿USDC，合计超过23亿美元。
current_state.en: Binance is still investigating a potential security incident; CZ said it appeared to have been hacked but that user funds are safe; Tether has frozen 1.567 billion USDT and Circle has frozen more than 800 million USDC, totaling over $2.3 billion.

updates.what_changed_zh: Binance suffered a $5.6B hack — the largest exchange theft ever — that reportedly wiped out its ~$1B SAFU insurance fund, with about $2.4B of the stolen USDT/USDC already frozen by Tether and Circle.
